Sort files by human readable size

c: du -sk * | sort -rn | awk '{ split( "KB MB GB" , v ); s=1; while( $1>1024 ){ $1/=1024; s++ } print int($1) v[s], $2 }'

l: Determine inode Usage ( This can take several minutes to complete )
p: In a directory where you suspect there might be a lot of inode usage run the following

c:
find . -type d |
while
    read line
    do
        echo "$( find "$line" -maxdepth 1 | wc -l) $line"
        done |
        sort -rn | less

l: List Linux processes using SWAP memory

c: for file in /proc/*/status ; do awk '/VmSwap|Name/{printf $2 " " $3}END{ print ""}' $file; done | sort -k 2 -n -r | less

l: List the free PV disk space not used by LVM

c:
freepe=$(sudo pvdisplay | grep 'Free PE' | awk '{ print $3 }') \
&& pesize=$(sudo pvdisplay | grep 'PE Size' | awk '{ print int( $3 ) }') \
&& mbpe=$(expr ${freepe} \* ${pesize}) && echo $(expr ${mbpe} / 1024) GB
